headline: Index-free and compressed structures speed sequence search and alignment at scale
label: Scalable Sequence Analysis Software
summary: Recent preprints and a published method target throughput, memory, and sensitivity limits of sequence search at terabase scale.
synthesis: The dominant thread across these items is engineering sequence search and alignment for throughput and memory efficiency at scale. IndelFreeAligner is a streaming, indel-free aligner that avoids reference pre-indexing and is benchmarked against Bowtie1 and BLAST+ on terabase-scale references. RSHash, a published method, is a compressed static k-mer hash built on rank-select bitvectors and layered minimizers, reported as about 40% faster than SSHash at equal memory. Reseek v3 is more accuracy-oriented, using parallel alignment over rich discrete structure alphabets with level-specific statistical models for protein structure search. What is new is the combination of index design, streaming execution, and alphabet choice, with the two sequence-level tools emphasizing speed and memory and Reseek v3 emphasizing accuracy.
